notes.title: Patch Notes RealLife | V0.1
notes.content:
PatchNote V0.1 | RealLife.

{ Additions | New: }

+ Beginning of the district "Résidence d'Aquitaine"
+ Added trees to the V0.1 map
+ Expansion and addition of several roads
+ Added a tarmac area
+ Added new markings
+ Added a Day/Night mode
+ Added several properties in "Résidence d'Aquitaine"
+ Added street lights to the map
+ Added road details
+ Added traffic lights
+ Addition of residence sign
+ Added a secondary menu > "ESC" when in game
+ Added numbers for homes

{ Changes: }

- Removal of unnecessary floating traffic lights
- Modification of the skybox
- Modification of action keys > "ZQSD"
- Modification of the main menu of the game (not final / still in development)

{ Information: }

i Other updates are expected very soon!
i PatchNote also available on DISCORD

/!\ It is FORBIDDEN to publish screenshots of the game for beta testers.

i Join the Discord if you haven't already: https://discord.gg/5D9bFq7jv3

/!\ Game still in development, please be forgiving, bugs may be encountered during your GamePlay, please report them to us on the Discord in the #💥•bugs room.
